description: This file defines a ViewModel class 'SearchViewModel' for an Android app, responsible for handling search logic for recipes filtered by ingredients. It manages query state, performs search operations via a repository, and exposes results for UI observation.

classes.name: SearchViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel for handling search queries and results related to recipes in the app, using LiveData and coroutine scope for asynchronous data fetching.

methods.name: updateQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query and triggers a new search.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search for recipes based on the current query asynchronously.
